exact_statement: For every Boolean h on a finite uniform shared cube, event A contained in {h=1} of probability 0<p<=1/2, and balanced Boolean V on independent private inputs, F=h+1_A(V-1) satisfies H(F)<=pH(V)+2H(h)+(3/4)H(1-2*1_A)+(15/2)I(1-2*1_A), in bits. Its actual shared influence J satisfies I(h)<=2J and I(1-2*1_A)<=2J, while its private influence is pI(V). Thus supplied nonnegative carrier/event FEI rates Ch,Ce transfer at max(Cchild,4Ch+(3/2)Ce+15) through finite balanced fresh-coordinate towers. For W_A equal to a private sign on A and 1 elsewhere, the universal optimal shared-only rate K* and Boolean FEI rate C* obey C*<=K*<=2C*, allowing infinity.
hypotheses: Uniform finite cubes; shared and private variables disjoint
V balanced; all mean/dummy and terminal rows retained
Numeric class closure requires supplied nonnegative carrier and event FEI certificates; no arbitrary-event certificate is assumed
proof_dependencies: Elementary finite Gibbs inequality, Parseval, edge isoperimetry (induction supplied), ln2>=2/3; no threshold/percolation theorem used
first_unproved_line: Universal supplied event/carrier source admission from the same unused original influence; already FEI-equivalent for constant carrier and one private sign. No full FEI proof.
